# Third-party code

Single-header libraries, unmodified, used by `proxy/model/model.cpp`.

| File | What | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cgltf.h` | glTF 2.0 parser (https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf) | 1.15 | MIT (notice at the end of the file) |
| `stb_image.h` | PNG and JPEG decoder (https://github.com/nothings/stb) | v2.30 | public domain or MIT (notice at the end of the file) |

The character models in `assets/models/` have their own credits in `assets/models/CREDITS.md`.
